client.name: Aegis of Valor
changes: Aegis of Valor no longer reduces LP losses in the case of defeat, and wins award double LP without requiring a minimum mastery score.

client.name: League Classic
changes: Our newest (oldest) game mode is coming to a server near you! Relive the glory days with League Classic . Marvel at what passed for modern graphical fidelity in the 2010s, outplay your opponents with point and click stuns and using old new items like Heart of Gold...!

Classic features 60 champions using classic versions of their gameplay across League's early history and is an experience that emphasizes strategy over mechanics and stronger consequences, both positive and negative, for your actions.

client.name: Ranked
changes: Ranked Season 3 will start at 12 PM on July 29, 2026 local server time. Victorious Ranked Mission (15 Ranked Games won) will be refreshed with season start, and end of S2 rewards will be distributed shortly after S3 start. Shard transfer service will be temporarily off until S2 rewards are granted.
Master players will now be able to duo, but only with players close to them in rank.
GM, Challenger, and players with GM or Challenger MMR will not be allowed to duo.
